db:select.db:sql: WITH ins AS ( INSERT INTO compliance_report_runs (run_id, report_type, entity_code, period_start, period_end, sequence_number, is_revision, record_count, total_amount, completeness_ok, triggered_by, run_status, started_at, correlation_id) SELECT :runId, :reportType, :entityCode, CAST(CAST(:periodStart AS text) AS timestamptz), CAST(CAST(:periodEnd AS text) AS timestamptz), s.seq, s.seq > 1, 0, 0, false, :triggeredBy, 'CLAIMED', now(), :correlationId FROM (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_number), 0) + 1 AS seq FROM compliance_report_runs WHERE report_type = :reportType AND entity_code = :entityCode AND period_start = CAST(CAST(:periodStart AS text) AS timestamptz)) s RETURNING run_id, sequence_number, is_revision ) SELECT run_id, sequence_number, is_revision FROM ins
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ runId: "RUN-" ++ upper((uuid() replace "-" with "")[0 to 15]), reportType: payload.reportType, entityCode: payload.entityCode, periodStart: payload.periodStart, periodEnd: payload.periodEnd, triggeredBy: payload.triggeredBy, correlationId: correlationId }]

db:select.db:sql: WITH upd_flags AS ( UPDATE transaction_flags SET report_status = 'REPORTED', reported_run_id = :runId WHERE flagged_at >= CAST(CAST(:periodStart AS text) AS timestamptz) AND flagged_at < CAST(CAST(:periodEnd AS text) AS timestamptz) AND report_status = 'PENDING_REPORT' RETURNING 1 ), upd_run AS ( UPDATE compliance_report_runs SET run_status = 'COMPLETED', record_count = :recordCount, total_amount = :totalAmount, customer_count = :customerCount, completeness_ok = true, is_nil_report = :isNil, output_file_path = :outputPath, archive_file_path = :archivePath, file_checksum = :checksum, completed_at = now() WHERE run_id = :runId RETURNING 1 ), upd_ctl AS ( UPDATE compliance_report_control SET last_reported_upto = GREATEST(last_reported_upto, CAST(CAST(:periodEnd AS text) AS timestamptz)), last_successful_run = :runId, last_sequence_number = :sequenceNumber, updated_at = now() WHERE report_type = :reportType RETURNING 1 ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upd_flags) AS flags_updated, (SELECT count(*) FROM upd_run) AS run_updated, (SELECT count(*) FROM upd_ctl) AS control_updated
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ runId: payload.runId, reportType: payload.reportType, periodStart: payload.periodStart, periodEnd: payload.periodEnd, sequenceNumber: payload.sequenceNumber as Number, recordCount: payload.recordCount as Number, totalAmount: payload.totalAmount as Number, customerCount: payload.customerCount as Number, isNil: payload.isNil as Boolean, outputPath: payload.outputPath, archivePath: payload.archivePath, checksum: payload.checksum }]

db:update.db:sql: UPDATE compliance_report_runs SET run_status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = :failureReason, completed_at = now() WHERE run_id = :runId
UPDATE compliance_report_runs SET notification_status = :notificationStatus WHERE run_id = :runId

db:select.db:sql: SELECT run_id, report_type, entity_code, to_char(period_start AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+05:30' AS period_start, to_char(period_end AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+05:30' AS period_end, sequence_number, is_revision, is_nil_report, record_count, total_amount, file_checksum, notification_status, run_status, triggered_by, failure_reason FROM compliance_report_runs WHERE run_id = :runId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { errorCode: "APP:RUN_NOT_FOUND", message: "No run found for the given runId" }

db:select.db:sql: SELECT run_id, report_type, entity_code, to_char(period_start AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+05:30' AS period_start, to_char(period_end AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '+05:30' AS period_end, sequence_number, is_revision, is_nil_report, record_count, total_amount, file_checksum, notification_status, run_status, triggered_by FROM compliance_report_runs WHERE (:status = 'ALL' OR run_status = :status) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT :limit
